police.label: Police station
police.description: Limestone ribs, bronze insignia, and a stepped Art Deco entrance.

fire.label: Fire station
fire.description: A brick firehouse with deep engine portals, slate dormers, and a hose tower.

hospital.label: Hospital
hospital.description: Stepped white wards, prominent medical crosses, and a separate red emergency canopy.

school.label: School
school.description: Warm brick wings, a bell cupola, and a welcoming play-and-learning garden.

jail.label: County jail
jail.description: A robust entrance lodge, secure exercise court, and restrained masonry.

college.label: College
college.description: A collegiate quadrangle, copper clock tower, cloisters, and a shaded court.

library.label: Library
library.description: A copper-vaulted reading room, timber archive wing, and a small public terrace.

museum.label: Museum
museum.description: A limestone colonnade, copper rotunda, and a curated sculpture forecourt.

landfill.label: Landfill
landfill.description: Managed earth cells and retaining walls that join into a larger working site.

incinerator.label: Incinerator
incinerator.description: A brick furnace hall, tapering stacks, loading doors, and exposed service ducts.

recycling.label: Recycling center
recycling.description: A folded green roof, clerestory glazing, and four clearly separated sorting bays.

wasteenergy.label: Waste-to-energy plant
wasteenergy.description: A blue boiler hall, glazed turbine gallery, and insulated district-heating pipes.

coal.label: Coal plant
coal.description: Brick turbine halls, twin masonry stacks, and a coal bunker feeding an elevated conveyor.

oil.label: Oil plant
oil.description: Bunded fuel tanks, an ochre boiler house, and a single striped exhaust stack.

gas.label: Gas plant
gas.description: Twin turbine modules, ribbed air intakes, slender exhausts, and a yellow gas manifold.

nuclear.label: Nuclear plant
nuclear.description: Hollow concrete cooling towers, domed containment, and a separate turbine hall.

wind.label: Wind turbine
wind.description: Three sculpted airfoil blades, a tapered white mast, and a compact transformer cabinet.

solar.label: Solar array
solar.description: Tilted blue photovoltaic rows on steel supports, with an inverter service lane.

microwave.label: Microwave plant
microwave.description: A concave satellite-power receiver, copper rectenna grids, and conversion equipment.

fusion.label: Fusion plant
fusion.description: An annular reactor enclosure, radial copper housings, and a teal control gallery.

waterpump.label: Water pump
waterpump.description: A copper-roofed brick wet-well house with paired teal pumps and exposed intake pipes.

watertower.label: Water tower
watertower.description: An elevated teal reservoir on splayed steel legs, with cross bracing and an access ladder.

desalination.label: Desalination plant
desalination.description: White membrane pressure-vessel racks, intake filters, and a clerestory process hall.

treatment.label: Water treatment
treatment.description: Twin open clarifiers, bridge-mounted drives, and baffled aeration channels beside a brick blower house.

park.label: Small park
park.description: Three neighborhood layouts: a fountain garden, gazebo garden, and playground.

variants.label: Fountain garden
variants.description: A stone fountain, flower beds, and shade trees around crossing paths.

variants.label: Gazebo garden
variants.description: A copper-roofed garden shelter, shaded seating, and flowering borders.

variants.label: Playground
variants.description: A timber swing, a small slide, and a sandy play area among trees.

largepark.label: Large park
largepark.description: An octagonal copper bandstand, lily pond, rose pergola, and generous tree-lined lawns.

zoo.label: Zoo
zoo.description: Twin entrance lodges, an open aviary, elephant and giraffe habitats, and a rocky penguin pool.

bus.label: Bus Stop
bus.description: A cantilevered glass shelter with sheltered seats, timetable and a clear boarding edge.

substation.label: Subway Station
substation.description: An open stair descends beneath a teal metro portal, with handrails and a ticket machine.

railstation.label: Rail Station
railstation.description: A brick ticket hall with a clock gable and a butterfly canopy over the boarding platform.

airport.label: Airport
airport.description: A glazed terminal, control tower, hangar and marked runway on a rectangular airfield.

seaport.label: Seaport
seaport.description: A working cargo yard with brick freight shed, stacked containers and a braced loading gantry.

variants.label: Cargo arrangement 1
variants.description: Five original deterministic container palettes, with shared yard circulation and lifting equipment.

variants.label: Cargo arrangement 2
variants.description: Five original deterministic container palettes, with shared yard circulation and lifting equipment.

variants.label: Cargo arrangement 3
variants.description: Five original deterministic container palettes, with shared yard circulation and lifting equipment.

variants.label: Cargo arrangement 4
variants.description: Five original deterministic container palettes, with shared yard circulation and lifting equipment.

variants.label: Cargo arrangement 5
variants.description: Five original deterministic container palettes, with shared yard circulation and lifting equipment.

mayorhouse.label: Mayor's House
mayorhouse.description: A warm domestic manor with a columned veranda, terracotta roof and private garden.

cityhall.label: City Hall
cityhall.description: A limestone municipal hall crowned by a square clock tower and copper lantern.

courthouse.label: Courthouse
courthouse.description: A six-column stone portico, carved pediment and broad public stair.

statue.label: Mayor's Statue
statue.description: A bronze civic figure on a layered stone plinth, with a plaque and low uplights.

university.label: University
university.description: A domed academic rotunda, faculty wings, lecture theatre and reading garden.

medcenter.label: Medical Research Center
medcenter.description: Paired laboratories, glazed skybridge, rooftop plant and a northlit public research hall.

stadium.label: Stadium
stadium.description: An open elliptical bowl with a striped pitch, tiered seating, canopies and floodlights.

variants.label: Teal seating
variants.description: The original lower-half seed palette, with teal seating around the open pitch.

variants.label: Red seating
variants.description: The original upper-half seed palette, with warm red seating around the open pitch.

marina.label: Marina
marina.description: A copper-roofed clubhouse, timber jetties and sculpted sailing yachts in a sheltered basin.

prison.label: Maximum Security Prison
prison.description: Stone perimeter towers, paired cell wings and a controlled gate with a central exercise court.

casino.label: Casino
casino.description: A stepped Art Deco hotel above a rounded gaming hall, with a gold entrance marquee.

variants.description: A stepped Art Deco hotel above a rounded gaming hall, with a gold entrance marquee.

toxicdump.label: Toxic Waste Dump
toxicdump.description: Segregated containment bunds, color-coded storage drums and a broad service aisle.

armybase.label: Army Base
armybase.description: Four pitched-roof barracks, a headquarters, parade square and controlled entrance.

gigamall.label: Gigamall
gigamall.description: Anchor stores flank a long glass lantern, with covered entrances and separate rear loading.

clocktower.label: Clock Tower
clocktower.description: A slender brick campanile with four clock faces, a copper spire and a planted square.

cathedral.label: Cathedral
cathedral.description: Twin stone spires frame a rose window, with a long nave, lower aisles and a projecting transept.

operahouse.label: Opera House
operahouse.description: A copper-domed auditorium, columned foyer and backstage fly tower, crowned by a golden lyre.

observatory.label: Observatory
observatory.description: An open silver telescope dome above a compact astronomy hall with low shielded lights.

aquarium.label: Aquarium
aquarium.description: Paired wave roofs cover a glazed marine hall, with shallow tidal exhibits beside the entrance.
